purpose: Freeze a materially distinct slow-trend plus intraday-event ensemble before any combined-data evaluation.
hypothesis: Use the admitted 30-day long/cash TSMOM as the primary allocation. When TSMOM is in cash, a statistically promising but not-admitted BTC shock -> high-beta alt lead-lag event may use otherwise idle capital. The combination is admitted only if the combined chronological OOS evidence passes every gate; neither component receives looser hurdles.

secondary_component.name: BTC 1h shock -> highest-beta alt 4h lead-lag
secondary_component.direction: same sign as completed BTC 1h shock
secondary_component.eligibility: only when the TSMOM account is in cash and no position is open

frozen_rules.collision_rule: TSMOM always has priority. A lead-lag position is not opened if it would overlap a pending or open TSMOM position. No forced early TSMOM exit is allowed to make room for lead-lag.
frozen_rules.weights: No optimized weights. One account, at most one position; normal target notional $5 and absolute entry-notional cap $10.
frozen_rules.funding: Exact settled funding included for any position crossing funding timestamps.
frozen_rules.minimums: Use decision-date/currently applicable Binance minimum-notional and quantity-step filters in execution-aware evaluation.
frozen_rules.intrabar: Use pessimistic ordering and adverse gap handling where applicable.

evaluation_protocol.data: Public market data only; no Binance credentials.
evaluation_protocol.development: Chronological development region only; never inspect either component's unopened sealed final while constructing the ensemble.
evaluation_protocol.sealed_final: One ensemble final segment, opened once only after all development gates pass.
minimum_development_gates: at least 2 of 3 chronological folds positive
risk and drawdown not worse than admitted TSMOM benchmark without compensating return improvement
evaluation_protocol.admission: Paper-only even if passed; live trading remains forbidden without separate explicit approval.

component_evidence_at_preregistration.tsmom: Historically admitted; base 3.33y +17.47%, PF 1.53; final 40% +5.75%, PF 1.49.
component_evidence_at_preregistration.lead_lag: Not admitted: 476 development events, +14.1869 bps mean after 14-bps round trip, all 3 folds positive, 20-bps stress +8.1869 bps, but t=1.3944 and one-sided p=0.08159 failed preregistered evidence gates; its sealed final remains unopened.

this_run.blocked_reason: The available local sandbox cannot reach public Binance/GitHub hosts, the Railway cron container is not running between jobs, and the connected Railway interface exposes no read-only one-off shell execution. Creating or redeploying a separate Railway research service would violate the frozen-runner/no-deployment constraint.
